Command: Do not diminish from the Law
Summary: Deuteronomy 12:32 guards the Law's wholeness from the other side: 'thou shalt not diminish from it.' Trimming God's word is as forbidden as enlarging it.
Commandment: Do not diminish from the Law.
Application: Scripture's stated reason: that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you (Deuteronomy 4:2).
Purpose: Scripture's stated reason: that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you (Deuteronomy 4:2).
Function: Deuteronomy 12:32 guards the Law's wholeness from the other side: 'thou shalt not diminish from it.' This binds in every age: a duty of conduct, not a rule of Israel's civil code. Scripture gives the reason: that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you. The restraint is the prohibition itself: do not diminish from the Law.
